Use DeepSeek

Your messages and device status, curves and brew records read on demand will be sent to DeepSeek. For web searches, necessary public search terms are also sent to DeepSeek. Search may incur extra charges, with at most two searches per reply. Charges apply to your API account. Do not enter secrets such as API keys. The current conversation, including drafts, full tool-call and reasoning protocol, and session statistics, is encrypted on this device and kept after closing this page or restarting. It is excluded from cloud backup. New chat clears the current conversation. Changing or deleting the API key hides the previous conversation. The app uses a 256K-token working budget (the model supports 1M), reserving 8K for output and space for tools. At roughly 200K conservatively estimated tokens for the complete request (system prompt, tool schemas, reasoning/tool history, attachments and new input), based on semantic UTF-8 text bytes plus structural allowances, an additional billed model call summarizes older conversation. This may happen before 200K actual tokens; provider usage can raise this budget but never replace the complete current estimate. Failed summaries are not automatically retried. Thinking and answers share the output budget. Full visible chat is retained; the model receives a summary and recent complete turns. Summaries never restore action authorization.

Send attachments to DeepSeek?

This sends your message, selected images/text and historical attachments still in working context to api.deepseek.com. Picking does not upload to DeepSeek; the system file provider may connect to read selected cloud files. Image/text model input is billed; later turns and automatic summaries may bill this content again. Images are re-encoded with metadata removed and may lose detail. Temporary requests are capped at 16 MiB; historical images trigger earlier summarization at 6 MiB to bound memory. Visible history remains. Attachments are untrusted data and grant no write authority. Cancel sends nothing; failures are never automatically retried.

Switch to %1$s?

Flash is recommended and accepts images/text; V4 Pro accepts text only and generally costs more. DeepSeek billing is authoritative. Both retain high safety, low reasoning and tool safeguards; no automatic downgrade or fallback. Each model has its own encrypted conversation: history, drafts and attachments remain and return when switching back. Reasoning/tool protocol is never transferred to the other model. Switching stays offline and cancels pending curve proposals. Account availability is unverified; service rejection preserves the session without resending to another model.

Extract document text first?

Upload this document to api.deepseek.com/v1/tools/ocr for text_recognition only. It does not understand charts, store the file in the Files API, or automatically start chat; this is not a guarantee of permanent deletion. The published parsing rate is USD 0.225 per 1,000 pages (2026-11-16), billed for successful pages. Actual page count is unknown before upload, so an exact total cannot be quoted. Official pricing is authoritative. Cancellation/disconnection may still complete and incur charges. Successful text is encrypted locally, checked against the 256K context budget, then requires a second chat-cost confirmation. Server-side recognition failure or timeout is not billed. Successful recognition can still produce incomplete text or exceed local/context budgets and prevent chat; successful recognition charges still apply. Client cancellation or an unknown outcome does not establish server-side failure. No automatic truncation or retry.
